# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 55 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_055_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 55

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever does not hate his father and his mother cannot be my disciple.

**2** And whoever does not hate his brothers and sisters and bear his cross in my way will not be worthy of me."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- moste: to hate; strong verb; same as Saying 43
- mathetnes: disciple; Greek loan-word
- stauros: cross; Greek loan-word
- axios: worthy; Greek loan-word
- cf. Matt 10:37-38; Luke 14:25-27 — the cost of discipleship saying
- Luke 14:26 uses "hate" as Thomas does; Matt 10:37 says "love more than me"
- Thomas adds "in my way" to the cross-bearing

---
